subject: GCP co-sell: PM sync & joint pipeline review — Nimbus Health listing
body:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@google.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell: PM sync & joint pipeline review — Nimbus Health listing

Hi Irene / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Nimbus Health is ready to move from initial discovery to formal co-sell engagement — they want help with listing readiness and joint GTM motions. I pulled together a short agenda for a partner manager + vendor PM sync so we can align on owners, timelines, and the co-sell capture plan.

Proposed agenda (30min):
- Quick intros and success criteria from Nimbus (Emily) — 5m
- Listing readiness checklist and gaps (Irene/Karthik) — 10m
- Joint pipeline review: top 5 opportunities, owners, next milestones (all) — 10m
- Action items & handoffs (Vanessa) — 5m

I attached the latest GCP co-sell playbook (v2) and a blank pipeline template — please review prior to the sync. Also linking the Nimbus deal in HubSpot here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5648392

Availability: I can do 9/15 or 9/16 between 10a–2p PT. What works for you?

—Priya
Priya Shah
Partner Manager, Google Cloud
priya.shah@google.com

-----Original Attachment: gcp_copilot_playbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
-----Original Attachment: nimbus_joint_pipeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)


From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: PM sync & joint pipeline review — Nimbus Health listing

Priya — thanks, this looks good. 9/15 at 10:30a PT works for me (blocking now).

Quick notes before the call so we can be efficient:
- Listing readiness: we need Nimbus to confirm the SLOs they expect from the product trial (latency targets, estimated QPS). If they want private deployment proofs, that's a different track — call that out at the top.
- Security/compliance: ask them if a SOC 2 or Data Processing Addendum is a hard requirement for PO. If yes, we'll need Sales + Security to start the questionnaire work immediately.
- Pricing: I will bring a recommended Dedicated vs Hosted comparison for the top 3 usage patterns we saw in discovery.

I've uploaded a short draft capture plan to Drive and shared with the thread (link below). Please add any must-have fields to the pipeline template before the call.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cPlaybook

Irene Choi
Senior Partner PM, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: PM sync & joint pipeline review — Nimbus Health listing

Thanks — putting a couple of technical notes in thread so we capture them before the sync: 

- Model footprint / hosting: Nimbus mentioned 4–6 concurrent inference streams during peak and very bursty traffic on weekends. For that profile I will prepare a config set for Dedicated with autoscale + burst and a hosted fallback variant for lower-cost dev environments.
- Trial data flow: we need to validate whether Nimbus wants to send PHI to the hosted service or keep it in VPC-only deployments. If PHI, we must line up the Private deployment lead and KMS expectations.
- Listing requirements: we usually need an architecture diagram, privacy/Data Processing Addendum confirmation, performance benchmarks for 3 sequence lengths, and a short runbook for onboarding. I'll draft those sections in the shared Drive doc tonight.

Action items for the call:
1) Irene — confirm SLO/bench targets with Nimbus ahead of time if possible.
2) Priya — confirm internal Google stakeholders for the co-sell and whether Marketplace listing support is available.
3) Vanessa — will you own deal tagging and marketplace listing intake after the call?

Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Irene / Priya — putting myself down as the marketplace intake owner for this one. I will: 
- Own the Marketplace intake form and coordinate any missing artifacts for the listing team.
- Tag the deal in HubSpot (RDW-GCP-3491) and add the partner contact details.
- Coordinate with Partnerships ops to schedule a separate listing checklist review if needed.

One ask for the call: can Nimbus prepare a short 2-slide summary of current infra and trial goals (latency/QPS / expected monthly MAUs)? That will make the listing and deployment recommendation much faster.

I will open a Marketplace intake ticket after the call and include the attachments.

Best,
